PLAN "Climbing-friendly Upper Body Rehab and Strength"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Pain-free shoulder stability and upper-body strength for climbing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Rehab & Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Shoulder-friendly upper":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          scapular_retraction_placeholder 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Pull emphasis, pain-free range":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 6m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Horizontal push with limits":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          chest_fly 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 6m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Shoulder-friendly upper":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:

          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Pull strength and core":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          plank 3x40..60 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20..30 rpe 7 rest 30 seconds

          lat_stretch 6m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Push control":

          rowing 8m

    WEEK 3:

          pallof_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 30 seconds

          back_stretch 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Push with scapular focus":

    WEEK 4:

      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Horizontal push & scapula":
